enriched_activities.desc: Lie face down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Place both arms under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Bend both knees. Pull the blanket back over the shoulder. Turn onto the right side. Extend the left arm out from under the pillow. Tuck the right hand under the cheek. Turn onto the back. Place both hands on the abdomen. Turn the head to the left. Turn onto the left side again. Push the pillow up under the head. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open both eyes. Push the blanket down. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Put on slippers. Walk out of Bedroom 2 and into the Bathroom. Reach for the light switch and press it. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap and rinse the mouth. Rinse the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Turn off the tap. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing breakfast for both, setting the table, and tidying the prep area before eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Press the Light switch on. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out eggs, milk, bread and butter. Close the Refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the Toaster and plug it in. Put two slices of bread into the Toaster. Press the lever down. Pick up the frying pan from the cupboard. Place the pan on the InductionCooker. Press the InductionCooker power button. Crack two eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula and turn the eggs. Press the RangeHood switch on. Open the cupboard and take out two plates, two cups and two sets of cutlery. Carry them to the table. Place one plate, one cup and one set of cutlery on each side of the table. Pick up the Kettle and fill it with water at the sink. Place the Kettle on its base. Press the Kettle switch on. Take the toast out of the Toaster and put it on a plate. Pick up the pan and slide the eggs onto the plates. Turn the InductionCooker off. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Rinse the pan in the sink and place it in the Dishwasher. Pour the boiled water into the cups. Say to Member 1: "Breakfast is ready."

Pull out the chair and sit down at the table. Pick up the fork and knife. Cut the egg. Lift the fork to the mouth and eat. Pick up the cup and drink the tea. Put the cup down. Pick up a slice of toast and bite it. Turn the head to Member 1 and say: "Do you want more toast?" Pick up the toast again and eat it. Pick up the cup and drink. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Push the plate forward. Stand up from the chair.

Pick up the plates from the table. Carry them to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Stack the plates and cups. Open the Dishwasher door. Load the plates, cups and cutlery into the Dishwasher rack. Close the Dishwasher door. Pick up the cloth and wipe the table. Wipe the countertop. Hang the cloth on the hook. Pick up the bread, butter and milk and put them back into the Refrigerator. Close the Refrigerator door. Press the Light switch off. Walk out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Final home workspace setup and reviewing exhibition and program schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Push the chair back from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the DeskLamp switch on. Press the SpaceHeater switch on. Open the laptop lid on the desk. Press the power button. Place the Monitor at the correct angle with both hands. Pick up the notebook and pen from the desk. Open the notebook. Turn the pages to the schedule list. Read the exhibition dates. Write two lines in the notebook. Pick up the phone and check the calendar app. Put the phone down on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator: drafting grant reports, coordinating with artists, and updating exhibition plans on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Move the mouse and click open the word processor. Type on the keyboard to draft the grant report. Press the save shortcut. Reach for the notebook and check the figures. Type the figures into the document. Open the email client. Click the inbox. Open an email from an artist. Type a reply on the keyboard. Press send. Pick up the phone and call an artist. Say: "Hello, I am confirming the installation date for your piece." Put the phone down. Open the spreadsheet of the exhibition plan. Click a cell. Type the updated dates. Click another cell and type the artist names. Press the save shortcut. Stand up from the chair. Reach for the water bottle on the desk. Twist the cap open. Lift the bottle and drink. Twist the cap closed. Sit down again. Scroll down the document with the mouse. Type two more paragraphs. Press the save shortcut. Lean back and stretch both arms up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1, making a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2 and into the Kitchen. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, noodles and sauce. Close the Refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife and cut the vegetables on the board. Place the pan on the InductionCooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables and stir with the spatula. Boil water in another pot. Add the noodles. Press the RangeHood switch on. Pick up two bowls and place them on the table. Pour the noodles and vegetables into the bowls. Fill the Kettle and press the switch on. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Pick up the chopsticks and eat. Say to Member 1: "How was your morning meeting?" Pick up the bowl and drink the soup. When the Kettle switches off, stand up, pour water into two cups and place a tea bag in each. Put the cups on the table. Sit down again. Pick up the cup and drink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up lunch dishes with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Pick up the bowls and cups. Carry them to the sink. Pick up the sponge and wipe the bowls. Hand the bowls to Member 1. Open the Dishwasher door. Load the bowls and cups into the rack. Close the Dishwasher door. Pick up the cloth and wipe the table. Pick up the cutting board and wash it under the tap. Place the board on the rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Pick up the Kettle and place it back on its base.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work: sketching and colouring commissioned artwork on the computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Sit down on the chair. Move the mouse to wake the screen. Click open the drawing software. Pick up the stylus from the desk. Draw the outline on the tablet. Press the undo key on the keyboard. Draw the outline again. Click the brush tool on the toolbar. Change the brush size with the slider. Draw the hair lines. Click the layers panel and add a new layer. Pick a colour from the palette. Fill the base colour with the fill tool. Adjust the Monitor angle with the left hand. Draw the shading strokes. Pick up the phone and open the references app. Scroll through the reference images. Put the phone down. Continue colouring with the stylus. Press the save shortcut. Stand up and stretch both arms. Sit down. Zoom in on the canvas with the mouse wheel. Draw small details on the eyes. Press the save shortcut.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a break, watching TV, and chatting with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Press the DeskLamp switch off. Walk out of Bedroom 2 and into the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 1. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Turn the head to Member 1 and say: "The client approved the sketch today." Pick up the cup from the coffee table and drink. Put the cup down. Point at the screen with the right hand. Pick up the phone and check messages. Put the phone down. Cross the legs on the sofa. Pick up the remote and press the volume button.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk into the Kitchen with Member 1. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out meat, vegetables and rice. Close the Refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife and cut the meat on the board. Place the pan on the InductionCooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the meat and stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Sprinkle salt with the spoon. Press the RangeHood switch on. Pick up two plates from the cupboard. Place them on the table. Spoon the food onto the plates. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Pick up the chopsticks and eat. Pick up the cup and drink water. Say to Member 1: "Let's watch the new episode after this." Put the chopsticks down. Push the plate forward.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a show and relaxing with Member 1; browsing illustration references on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair in the Kitchen. Walk into the Living Room with Member 1. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control and press the power button. Press the menu button. Select the show with the arrow buttons. Press the play button. Put the remote down on the cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the phone with the finger. Open the illustration app. Scroll through the reference gallery. Tap an image to enlarge it. Zoom in with two fingers. Tap the save button. Lock the phone. Put the phone down on the cushion. Pick up the remote and press the pause button. Say to Member 1: "I will get water, do you want some?" Stand up. Walk to the Kitchen. Fill two cups at the tap. Walk back to the Living Room. Hand one cup to Member 1. Sit down. Press the play button on the remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Press the TV power button off with the remote. Put the remote into the drawer. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the two cups from the coffee table. Carry them to the Kitchen sink. Walk back to the Living Room. Pick up the cushions and place them on the sofa in order. Fold the blanket on the sofa. Pick up the magazines and stack them on the shelf. Open the cupboard. Take out the VacuumCleaner. Plug the VacuumCleaner into the socket. Press the power button. Push the VacuumCleaner across the floor with the right hand. Move the nozzle under the coffee table. Pull the VacuumCleaner back. Push it along the sofa edge. Say to Member 1: "Please lift the chair." Push the VacuumCleaner under the chair. Pull it out. Press the power button off. Unplug the VacuumCleaner. Wind the cord around the hooks. Open the cupboard and place the VacuumCleaner inside. Close the cupboard door.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal art practice: drawing in a sketchbook at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the Living Room and into Bedroom 2. Pull out the chair and sit down at the desk. Press the DeskLamp switch on. Reach to the shelf and take down the sketchbook. Place the sketchbook on the desk. Open the pencil case. Pick up a pencil. Draw a vertical line on the paper. Draw a circle above the line. Add curved lines around the circle. Pick up the eraser and rub out a line. Put the eraser down. Pick up the pencil again. Draw the outlines of a figure. Add hatching lines with short strokes. Turn the sketchbook to the next page. Draw a second figure. Pick up the ruler and draw a straight border line. Put the ruler down. Pick up the pencil and shade the corner. Close the sketchbook. Put the pencil back into the pencil case. Zip the pencil case closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Press the DeskLamp switch off. Walk out of Bedroom 2 and into the Bathroom. Press the Light switch on. Press the WaterHeater switch on. Open the shower door. Turn the shower tap to the left. Step into the shower. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap and rub it on the body. Rinse the body. Turn the tap off. Push the shower door open. Pick up the towel from the hook. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the body. Pick up the toothbrush and brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Hang the towel on the hook. Press the Light switch off. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Press the SpaceHeater switch off. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Open the book to the bookmark. Hold the book with both hands. Turn one page. Turn another page. Reach to the desk and press the DeskLamp switch off. Fold the corner of the page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Place the phone on the bedside table face down. Close both eyes.
